arxiv-2012-12768.title: Near field propulsion forces from nonreciprocal media
arxiv-2012-12768.creator: David Gelbwaser-Klimovsky, Noah Graham, Mehran Kardar, Matthias Krüger
arxiv-2012-12768.description: Abstract Arguments based on symmetry and thermodynamics may suggest the existence of a ratchet-like lateral Casimir force between two plates at different temperatures and with broken inversion symmetry. We find that this is not sufficient, and at least one plate must be made of nonreciprocal material. This setup operates as a heat engine by transforming heat radiation into mechanical force.

arxiv-2106-00299.title: Three Dimensional Orientation of Complex Molecules Excited by Two-Color Femtosecond Pulses
arxiv-2106-00299.creator: Long Xu, Ilia Tutunnikov, Yehiam Prior, Ilya Sh. Averbukh
arxiv-2106-00299.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Long Xu, Ilia Tutunnikov, Yehiam Prior, Ilya Sh. Averbukh. We study the excitation of asymmetric-top (including chiral) molecules by two-color femtosecond laser pulses. In the cases of non-chiral asymmetric-top molecules excited by an orthogonally polarized two-color pulse, we demonstrate, classically and quantum mechanically, three-dimensional orientation. For chiral molecules, we show that the orientation induced by a cross-polarized two-color pulse is enantioselective along the laser propagation direction, namely, the two enantiomers are oriented in opposite directions.

arxiv-2106-08628.title: Coastal imbalance: generation of oceanic Kelvin waves by atmospheric perturbations
arxiv-2106-08628.creator: Jacques Vanneste
arxiv-2106-08628.description: Abstract The response of a semi-infinite ocean to a slowly travelling atmospheric perturbation crossing the coast provides a simple example of the breakdown of nearly geostrophic balance induced by a boundary. We examine this response in the linear shallow-water model at small Rossby number ε ≪ 1 \varepsilon\ll 1 .

arxiv-2202-05750.title: Bounded nonlinear forecasts of partially observed geophysical systems with physics-constrained deep learning
arxiv-2202-05750.creator: Said Ouala, Steven L. Brunton, Bertrand Chapron, Ananda Pascual, Fabrice Collard, Lucile Gaultier, Ronan Fablet ( 1 ) (1) IMT Atlantique; Lab-STICC, 29200 Brest, France ( 2 ) (2) University of Washington, USA ( 3 ) (3) Ifremer, LOPS, 29200 Brest, France ( 4 ) (4) IMEDEA, UIB-CSIC, 07190 Esporles, Sp
arxiv-2202-05750.description: Abstract The complexity of real-world geophysical systems is often compounded by the fact that the observed measurements depend on hidden variables. These latent variables include unresolved small scales and/or rapidly evolving processes, partially observed couplings, or forcings in coupled systems. This is the case in ocean-atmosphere dynamics, for which unknown interior dynamics can affect surface observations.

arxiv-2303-04924.title: Emergent topological quantum orbits in the charge density wave phase of kagome metal CsV 3 Sb 5
arxiv-2303-04924.creator: Hengxin Tan, Yongkang Li, Yizhou Liu, Daniel Kaplan, Ziqiang Wang, Binghai Yan
arxiv-2303-04924.description: Abstract The recently discovered kagome materials A A V 3 Sb 5 ( A A = K, Rb, Cs) attract intense research interest in intertwined topology, superconductivity, and charge density waves (CDW). Although the in-plane 2 × 2 2\times 2 CDW is well studied, its out-of-plane structural correlation with the Fermi surface properties is less understood.

arxiv-2303-10558.description: Abstract GRB 221009A is the brightest gamma-ray burst ever detected. arxiv-2510-15689.title: More on Boundary Behavior of Univalent Harmonic Mappings
arxiv-2510-15689.creator: Gebreslassie Atsbha Weldegebrial Hunduma Legesse Geleta
arxiv-2510-15689.description: Abstract Abstract Many authors have examined various boundary behaviors of injective harmonic mappings in the open unit disk. Building on Laugesen’s work, Bshouty and others explored the boundary behavior of harmonic mappings under different conditions. In this paper, we extend their work and find out the angular limits of the arguments and logarithms of analytic functions under various conditions.

pmc-11478513.title: Auxin-Mediated Lateral Root Development in Root Galls of Cucumber under Meloidogyne incognita Stress
pmc-11478513.creator: Baoling Ren, Xin Guo, Jingjing Liu, Guifang Feng, Xiaodong Hao, Xu Zhang, Zhiqun Chen, Zafar Ahmad Handoo
pmc-11478513.description: Root-knot nematodes induce the formation of feeding sites within the host roots and the relocation of auxin into galls results in abnormal lateral root growth. Here, we analyzed the changes in cucumber root architecture under Meloidogyne incognita stress and the distribution of auxin in these morphological and molecular root changes.

pmc-11594291.title: Microorganism Diversity Found in Blatta orientalis L. (Blattodea: Blattidae) Cuticle and Gut Collected in Urban Environments
pmc-11594291.creator: Constanza Schapheer, Luciano Matías González, Cristian Villagra, Changlu Wang, Chow-Yang Lee
pmc-11594291.description: Simple SummaryUrban cockroaches raise health concerns due to their association with pathogens. However, their microbial associates can enhance their physiological and reproductive functions. This article details the bacterial community associated with the oriental cockroach Blatta orientalis Linnaeus, 1758 (Blattodea: Blattidae) using metabarcoding for the first time.

pmc-12963023.title: Temporal Characteristics and Management of Prolonged Sinus Pause Following Atrial Fibrillation Termination After Catheter Ablation—A Preliminary Study
pmc-12963023.creator: Yi Guo, Cheng Cai, Hongwu Chen, Kai Gu, Weizhu Ju, Gang Yang, Jiaojiao Shi, Zidun Wang, Hailei Liu, Xiaohong Jiang, Chang Cui, Mingfang Li, Minglong Chen
pmc-12963023.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionProlonged sinus pause (PSP) after atrial fibrillation (AF) termination shortly after catheter ablation seems to be a reversible phenomenon without further need for pacemaker implantation (PMI). However, no mature management strategy has been established.MethodsIn this prospective observational study, we included consecutive patients who developed PSP ≥ 3 s upon AF termination during hospitalization following AF ablation at our center between October 2020 and October 2022. Regular follow‐up was conducted.ResultsTwelve patients (mean age 66.3 ± 8.5 years; 7 females) were included.

uslaw-usc-t42-s13284.title: 42 U.S.C. § 13284 — Cost-sharing
uslaw-usc-t42-s13284.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s13284.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 134 (Energy Policy); Subchapter IV (Electric Motor Vehicles); Part A (Electric Motor Vehicle Commercial Demonstration Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Requirement The Secretary shall require at least 50 percent of the costs directly and specifically related to any project under this part to be from non-Federal sources. Such share.
